Trinamool Congress faction removes Mamata Banerjee as party chief

A faction within the Trinamool Congress (TMC) has announced the removal of Mamata Banerjee from her position as party chief. The rebel group, led by Ritabrata Banerjee, also formed a national working committee and suspended Abhishek Banerjee. The faction has appointed Arup Roy as the new chairman of the party.
